sanitizedDescription: Value stored to 'gdp' is never read
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 0301ffab3d9.c (ext2fs). 'Value stored to gdp is never read' at line 8 ('gdp = "group_desc"' inside #ifdef EXT2FS_ENABLE_SWAPFS). 'gdp' IS used at line 10 ('printf("%c\n", (*gdp)++)') as the pointer to dereference. Desugaring artifact: the presence condition requires __need___FILE=true AND EXT2FS_ENABLE_SWAPFS=true. '__need___FILE' is an internal stdio header guard. When '__need___FILE=true', the stdio.h desugaring places 'printf' inside a conditional if-block. In the desugared form, 'printf("%c\n", (*gdp)++)' is inside 'if(!__need___FILE){...}'. When __need___FILE=true, this if-block is not entered, making 'gdp' appear as a dead store (assigned at line 7 but never read on the __need___FILE=true path). The bug fires with __need___FILE=true — a non-standard/unusual header guard combination that is a desugaring artifact.
